scope: Read-only feasibility research against installed binaries and official documentation; no implementation, game launch, server restart or configuration changes.

comparisons.existing: FTF already uses owned selection plans, sampler decoration and preview owners. Preview color modes read Cell.temperature and Cell.moisture directly. TerraLatitude currently only owns server-world samples.
comparisons.new_work: Provide an immutable climate profile for preview owners; update climate displays separately. A deeper raw-cell integration needs a nonrecursive extension boundary before cache publication.
comparisons.feasibility: Reasonable medium effort; staged integration, not a new climate-selection engine.

comparisons.existing: Terrain populators already fill terrain-correlated erosion/weirdness. FTF selects from complete multi-noise targets and supports normalized placement decorators. Installed Still Life uses terrain-appropriate base-biome targets with T/H conditions.
comparisons.new_work: Audit/tune existing targets, ranges, regions and fallback coverage. Add direct landform constraints only for observed unmet requirements.
comparisons.feasibility: High feasibility as data/pack refinement; a parallel biome-selection engine is unnecessary.

comparisons.existing: Coasts/oceans and continent geometry exist; moisture boost uses inverse normalized inland elevation, not physical ocean distance. OceanClimateProjection changes continentalness, not temperature.
comparisons.new_work: A geographic coastal-exposure or distance approximation, possibly maritime temperature/moisture influence. Validate across islands and continent models; continentDistance must not be assumed to mean block distance to shore.
comparisons.feasibility: Reasonable bounded approximation, medium effort; full ocean circulation/seasonal climate is much larger.

comparisons.existing: rainShadowStrength raises moisture to an exponent based on normalized elevation. No wind, upwind barrier sampling, or ocean fetch in this modifier.
comparisons.new_work: Terrain-only, bounded coarse upwind sampling with deterministic owner/profile caches; reconcile current elevation drying.
comparisons.feasibility: Plausible experimental feature, highest complexity here; unbenchmarked. Avoid getChunk, full getBaseHeight and Streams network dependencies.

comparisons.existing: FTF carves river/valley/wetland geometry and picks tagged river candidates with the climate target. Streams supports bank styles and features selected by biome/tags, plus climate-dependent width.
comparisons.new_work: Prefer custom bank styles/features before a new biome system. A future shared-moisture adapter to Streams is distinct from bank decoration and could affect hydrology.
comparisons.feasibility: High feasibility for bank configuration; medium/higher for ecological biome belts or hydrology adaptation. FTF masks do not establish coverage of every Streams channel.
comparisons.additional_observation: UpliftRiverCarver sets moisture=1 in its riverbed method, but ordinary Heightmap.apply runs rivers then climate and ClimateModule.apply overwrites moisture. This assignment alone does not prove a persistent riparian moisture belt.

comparisons.existing: FTF warps/smooths region boundaries and terrain regions; TerraLatitude smooths climate values. Lithostitched supports conditional replacements. These do not guarantee a specific ecological sequence.
comparisons.new_work: Use existing placement mechanisms to populate compatible intermediate climate niches. Exact adjacency guarantees require new logic and are not assured by smooth noise.
comparisons.feasibility: Reasonable as targeted data refinement; defer a generalized adjacency engine.

additional_verified_gap: Streams NeoForgePlatformHelper.biomeWetness uses Biome.getModifiedClimateSettings().downfall(), not TerraLatitude continuous humidity. A conversion must not equate Minecraft humidity directly with physical rainfall.
inspection_method: Installed JAR bytecode and official project documentation; no game/server launch or implementation benchmark.
priorities_superseded_by: ../INTEGRATION-SPEC.md: geographic moisture, directional rain shadows and Streams hydrology adaptation are now deferred.
historical_research_priorities: Integrate TerraLatitude into existing preview/diagnostics with identical immutable world settings.
Audit and tune biome placements plus Streams bank styles before inventing new selection systems.
Prototype geographic ocean influence with bounded cost.
Prototype directional rain shadows only after baseline profiling.
Consider a separate one-way moisture adapter into Streams; climate must never wait on Streams networks.
historical_validation_ideas: Compare generation, preview and climate map at identical positions and saved settings.
Measure overhead before/after any terrain sampling extension.
Use east-west transects at similar latitude/elevation to establish geographic moisture effect.
Verify generated chunks as well as predicted biome outputs.
Keep old saved climate profiles reproducible; new algorithms must be versioned/opt-in.
scope_status: Historical feasibility findings, not the current development scope. INTEGRATION-SPEC.md governs the next iteration; advanced geographic climate and Streams hydrology changes are deferred.
